title: Combination Therapy for the Treatment of Bipolar Disorders
brief_summary: This study will compare triple and double drug regimens in the treatment of patients with depression, hypomania, or mania.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Bipolar I or II Disorder
* Meet criteria for rapid cycling, defined as four or more episodes over the past 12 months
* Meet criteria for a major depressive episode

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of intolerability of lithium, divalproex, or lamotrigine
